text: Fire dampers shall be installed where ducts pass through fire compartment boundaries of the Fire Regulation and NFPA 850 with a rating not less than that of the partition (minimum 90 minutes for electrical rooms and 120 minutes for the boundary of the control building), be tested to the relevant standard, be accessible for inspection and fitted with position feedback; ductwork in fire rated shafts may replace the dampers when tested as rated.
